fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-08-06, around 21:30, messages threatening harm were sent to the complainant following a disagreement over a parking issue, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-08-10. The complaint was lodged by Indhu Murugan (9000000163). An unidentified caller using the number 9000000188 was mentioned in the complaint. Dinesh Subramani (9000000212) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint refers to Arun Muthu, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000304. Items referenced in the complaint: a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Messages reportedly sent from an unfamiliar number.
